name: SDN Host Random Node
description: Host CSPRNG connector (typed contracts 1.0). Method "bytes" takes an optional "request" frame, a $RND (SDS standard RND) stating LENGTH (0 = 32; 1..8192, larger refused with invalid-length), samples random.bytes (SDS $PIV hostcall: RandomBytesParams LENGTH, the bytes on raw "data") and clock.now, and emits one "bytes" frame, a $RND: LENGTH, BYTES verbatim from the host, SOURCE SystemCsprng, GENERATED_AT_MS. No JSON. Host gating: the Go node serves random.* and clock.* as ungated built-ins (and refuses LENGTH > 8192); the SDK NodeHost/BrowserHost are default-deny and need the "random" and "clock" capability grants, which this node declares.

externalInterfaces.description: Host CSPRNG and clock hostcalls as SDS $PIV invocations (random.bytes -> raw "data"; clock.now -> TimeValue UNIX_MS). Go server host: built-in; SDK NodeHost/BrowserHost: capability-gated.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Optional $RND request: LENGTH bytes wanted (0 = 32, max 8192); SOURCE Unspecified or SystemCsprng; BYTES empty.
$RND: LENGTH, BYTES (exactly LENGTH bytes from random.bytes, verbatim), SOURCE SystemCsprng, GENERATED_AT_MS (clock.now).

outputPorts.description: The generated random bytes as one $RND frame.

methods.description: Requests LENGTH random bytes from the host CSPRNG through the sync typed hostcall bridge (SDS $PIV) and emits them in one $RND frame.
